role: The native twin of the oracle's determinism layer netherite.oracle.Det: java.util.Random streams (including nextGaussian with fdlibm's StrictMath.log), the per-role seeder and Math.random streams, per-role entity ids and UUIDs, the name-seeded split Randoms that replace vanilla's static Randoms, reset(seed), the stream digests Rows.java writes, and snapshot load of the stream states.
gpu: line 318, function det_split_random: calloc of a det_split node; reached inside the tick when a caller registers a split lazily (dragon.c enchantment_damage_roll calls it on first use)
line 323-326, function det_split_random: splits are a singly linked list (pointer graph) appended at the tail by walking it
line 331-335, function det_split_find: linear strcmp search of the split list by name, order and length unbounded by data
line 342-344, function det_split_index: index found by walking the linked list
line 464-470, function det_split_state: digest walks the linked list; order free by construction (sum), so container order does not matter here
line 142-147, function det_rng_gaussian: rejection-sampling do/while with no fixed bound (as in java.util.Random.nextGaussian)
notes: Java's java.util.Random is not in oracle/src, so it is not listed; det_rng_* delegate the LCG to jrand.h and add the per-instance nextGaussian cache. det_log is fdlibm __ieee754_log (StrictMath.log), det_sqrt is libm sqrt. Not ported from Det.java: installShuffle/shufState, otherDraws and clientNews (the header says otherDraws and clientNews are write-only or --detail forensics; installShuffle was not checked). Recordings: out/java/det is the DetProbe dump test_det.c compares against. Nearly every native test exercises this file indirectly (24 tests call det_ functions). det_pin_* port Det's client consumer pin (Det.pinSeed and TickRandom): the playable client's flicker and item streams and particles_live's pinned mode. det_spawner_display_yaw: Det.PIN_SPAWNER's head turn of a spawner's display mob (lane/idxclient);
